issue_request: FHIR-3125 is a Published/Persuasive OO change request asking FHIR-core Observation.value[x] to allow DateTime for simple date/time observations; the recorded resolution was to add DateTime as a choice in Observation.value[x].
initial_application: The Jira comments say the change was applied to the build pending OO approval. additional_context: Observation is active in the current build via source/fhir.ini. The current source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml includes a #3125 committee note and dateTime in the allowed type list for Observation.value[x], and the parallel Observation.component.value[x] choice also includes dateTime. Zulip and Confluence searches found no direct FHIR-3125 discussion or conflicting later work-group evidence.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The combined branch received an empty no-change audit commit because the current authoritative source already implements the requested dateTime choice.
source_changes: None; empty audit commit because the active Observation StructureDefinition source already includes dateTime.
